neighbours.label: multiple sclerosis and myelin disease vocabulary (sclerosis, MS, myelin, demyelinating)
fire: Her neurologist confirmed a diagnosis of multiple sclerosis last spring.
Relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis are treated with interferon drugs.
Damage to the myelin coating slows signals along the nerve.
Doctors suspected a demyelinating disease after the optic neuritis.
Oligodendrocytes produce the myelin that wraps axons in the brain.
Chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy weakens the arms and legs.
The charity raises money for people living with MS and their families.
Remyelination is the goal of several new experimental drugs.
quiet: Her neurologist confirmed a diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease last spring.
Severe forms of epilepsy are treated with anticonvulsant drugs.
Damage to the retina slows vision in the left eye.
Doctors suspected a viral infection after the high fever.
Astrocytes supply the glucose that feeds neurons in the brain.
Chronic migraine with aura weakens concentration at work.
The charity raises money for people living with diabetes and their families.
Pain relief is the goal of several new experimental drugs.

notes: Probes: fires on 'multiple sclerosis', 'demyelinating', 'myelin', 'relapses' under MS, and white-matter lesions; quiet on Parkinson's. 'MS' as a degree fires only weakly, so this is a meaning, not just a token. Trigger declared for coverage.
